dataList.content:
Now, men! Clear orders and solidarity are of paramount importance in times like these!
好，诸位！在这种危机时刻，最重要的就是明确的指挥与坚定服从的团结！
dataList.place:
Aboard Mephistopheles's Deck
梅菲斯托费勒斯 甲板

dataList.content:
Right leg on 'HEAVE', left leg on 'HO'! Let's go!
我喊“嘿！”就动右脚，喊“唷！”就动左脚。

HEAVE!
嘿！

HO!
唷！

HEAVE!
嘿！

... HEAVE HO HOW is it fair that you get to stand there barkin' orders at us while we're pedaling our bums off?
……唷你个头啊，你怎么一滴汗都不流就光在那站着？

A most dimwitted question. A Captain must preserve her strength, or risk putting her subordinates in danger.
愚蠢。船长损耗体力会让所有部下陷入危险之中。

That is precisely why I am refraining from partaking in this collaborative effort myself!
为了保存体力，我当然不会投身于此！

... Since when were you our Commander?
……你什么时候当上队长了？

<Well, she did say she's the Captain, not the Commander...>
<她说不是队长是船长……>

Those damn seagulls can flock off already.
该死的鸟。从刚才起就让人火大。

How 'bout we kidnap them seagulls and train them to pedal the generator?
……就不能把那群要饭的海鸥抓过来训练一下，让它们去踩发电机吗？

Oi, Faust! Smartarse! I thought you were a genius; make it so! That should be easy-peasy for your brilliant intellect, no?
喂，了不起的浮士德小姐。你不是无所不知吗？那种程度的技术以你的头脑三下五除二就能捣鼓出来了吧？！

I can make it happen, indeed. Yet I do not, as it is inefficient. Rudimentary toilet training will be the first step in making them viable as a consistent source of labor.
虽然并非不可能，但效率会十分低下。毕竟要从基础的排泄训练开始起步。

Charon's bored. Charon wants to vroom-vroom.
卡戎，好无聊。卡戎想要驾驶。

I'm tagging out. You're the driver, so do your job. That should keep you occupied for a while.
换班。你这司机来摇发电机好了。正好你还挺闲。

Oho, ya sure about that? Vergie's not gonna let that slide~ That's how ya get yourself a 'consultation', y'know?
哎呀，你确定吗？维吉大概不会无动于衷哦~你想被拉去面谈吗？

Haah... Wait...! Let's think about this for a hot minute.
哈啊……等下……！咱们还是再仔细、仔细考虑一下吧。

Let's think about the actual reason we're sweating, pedaling the crap out of the generator, huh?
探讨一下非要这么汗流浃背地摇发电机的……根本原因吧。嗯？

... To nitpick and seek someone to take the fall for every little thing is... a stinking thought. All that happens on the road to success is merely a part of the process.
……对所有的结果都要一一追究原因与责任是一种很糟糕的想法。只要最终结果是成功的，那么在此之前的一切也不过是过程而已。

Look, I'm not saying that we should play the blame game. I'm just wondering why we're pedaling so darn hard to begin with. It's not like there's something coming after us.
不是，我不是要怪谁，就是好奇为什么非要像被催命似的加速啊。

We're headed toward one of the largest ports of U Corp., and we know exactly where that is and how to get there.
我们的目的地是U公司的大型港口之一吧。目的地、方向不都明确把握了吗。

It's not like the port's gonna sail away, right? Why all this urgency?
那港口又不会移动，为什么要这么着急啊？

I mean, am I wrong? The Great Lake has been very tranquil so far. It's not like some monster's going to suddenly appear out of nowhere and attack us, right?
不是，我应该没说错吧？在这么风平浪静的大湖里，又不会突然冒出个怪物，然后还提前寄来要把我们全杀光的预告信什么的。

It appears that your consolidated field experience has evolved into a form of intuition. Fascinating, Gregor.
看来你借由积累的经验在某种程度上获得了更准确的直觉，格里高尔。真有趣。

What...?
嗯……？

Faust finds this development optimistic.
浮士德认为这是一种积极的转变。

We must exit this area within the next 10 minutes. We are... falling somewhat behind the forecast of my predictions.
我们需要在接下来的10分钟之内离开这片区域。所以……现在比预想中的要滞后了一些。

Okay... that was ominous. Why precisely 10 minutes?
嗯……我有点不祥的预感，为什么时间要说得这么具体？

The 'laws of the Great Lake'.
因为“大湖的规则”。

Ohh... I knew it! It's that darn law of the Great Lake again, huh?!
噢……果然……是因为那个规则吗？！

Your foreknowledge of the laws of the Great Lake is an unexpected development, Rodion. Quite difficult to believe that, even with the consolidated experience, your intuition would—
罗佳，你居然出乎预料地对大湖的规则有所了解。比起说是直觉如此敏锐……

Sorry, sorry~ I just wanted to look like I was in on it for once. Girl gets tired of asking every time, ya know.
抱歉~这次是不懂装懂啦。每次都要问一下也太无聊了不是嘛？

The Great Lake of U Corp. has laws that... must never be broken.
……U公司的大湖有着必须遵守的规则。

And yes. The port can and will sail away, Gregor.
以及与格里高尔先生所言相反，港口是会移动的。

It's a bloody lake... What laws could it possibly have?
啥……现在就连一片湖都有规矩了？

What, are the Lake coppers going to come spank the bad boys with a stick for breaking class rules?
要是有违规的学生，这片湖还能拿起戒尺不成？

There better be a law that lets me SYNC, whiny brat. My ears are starting to bleed.
就没有把叽叽喳喳的家伙折·脖的规则吗？我耳朵疼。

'Haah... Guys, knock it off.'
“哈啊，都适可而止吧。”

I could almost hear a well-timed sigh followed by honest but brutal, piercing words. It was like someone recorded her sigh and played it in my head.
仿佛听到了绝妙的叹息与深入肺腑的毒舌。不，更像是脑袋里打开了录音机一般，清晰地传入耳中。

But Ishmael was nowhere to be seen on the deck.
但这甲板上不论哪里都找不到以实玛利的踪迹。

So, if there's anything you want from me from now on, state it. Clearly.
所以，往后要是对我有什么要求，请明确地。提出来。

She wasn't kidding. Ishmael remained in her room, not a peep to be seen nor heard despite the commotion.
正如她留下的那句话一般，以实玛利无视着所有骚动，只是待在自己的房间里。

Not appearing once through all that's happened since... the incident.
在这一切发生之时，她也没有露过一次面。

As much as I would like to provide you with an explanation, leaving this zone takes precedence.
虽然我想解释一下，但我更想说，眼下离开这个区域的优先级更高。

According to my calculations, our last conversation left us with 7 minutes.
算上刚刚的对话所消耗的时间，大约剩下7分钟。

We are approximately 15km away from the edge of this zone as the crow flies.
若要离开此区域，沿直线距离航行大约还剩15km。

Each person must pedal to generate enough energy to travel at least 10km per hour if we are to escape in time.
需要人均承担时速10km以上的推进力才能安全通过。

Wonderful. I love to see some proper teamwork for once.
今天你们尤为团结啊。真是令人欣慰的景色。

Hyaah! Rocinante! Our destination is nigh! Gallop on!
前进吧！驽骍难得！目的地近在眼前！奔跑吧！

Where does... that girl... get her energy from... Ugh, augh...
那孩子怎么……这么活力四射啊……呃、呃……

Cough, cough... I think I'm done for... Just go on ahead without me...
咳咳……我……已经不行了……把我扔在这儿吧……

And leave you where... We're on... a ship... agh.
能把你……扔去哪儿啊……呜。

Hup. Hup. Hup. Hup.
呼。呼。呼。呼。

Diaphragmatic breathing is conducive to maintaining consistent speed in an exercise of this intensity.
对于这种强度的脚踏运动，腹式呼吸最为有效。

Especially more so when each Sinner is responsible for about 10km per hour of energy output. Any higher and it would have required hyperpnea to maintain that speed.
对于承担时速10km程度所需的推进力确实如此。但若需要进一步的负荷时就需要把口鼻全部用上了。

Do you ever get tired, girl?!
亲爱的你就不累么？！

No. 3 minutes remaining, now.
嗯，嘛。还剩3分钟。

Aough... We don't even know what happens in 3 minutes! Why are we doing this?!
啊呜……连会发生什么事都不知道，就这么光消耗体力有什么意义啊？！

<She said there's no time! Just step on it with your life!>
<不是说没时间说明了吗！目前就先尽全力蹬脚踏板吧！>

Charon wanted to vroom-vroom. This is squeak-squeak.
卡戎，想要布隆布隆……这个是嘎吱嘎吱。

Squeak-squeak. That's no fun.
嘎吱嘎吱，不好玩。

Hm hm hm~ I didn't know how energizing work songs could be.
嗯哼~哼着歌劳动也很能提神呢。

Huuh?! How do you guys have so much energy left?
什么呀？！怎么不累的人这么多啊？

This is not even a warm-up compared to the training my family forced me to do~
比起我在家里接受的强制修炼，这都算不上是费力啦~

Ach, you lot! Shut your gobs and pedal!
咳，都拉倒吧，赶紧蹬啊！

30 seconds remaining.
目前还有30秒。

Khaaaa! Quite the thrill this is!!! Now this! Is true adventure!!!
哈啊啊！惊心动魄！！！这才叫冒险啊！！！

'Tis like charging an overwhelmingly colossal enemy, is it no— Ach?! Cough! Ack!
仿若向着庞大的敌人突进……呃啊？！咳！咳啊！

Save your words. Your breathing. Remain. In the flow. Breathe in. Out. Breathe in. Out. Breathe in. Out. Breathe in. Out. Breathe in. Out.
节省语句，调整呼吸。否则节奏会被打乱。吸气，呼气，吸气，呼气，吸气，呼气，吸气，呼气，吸气，呼气……

Huff... Huff... How... much... time...
哈……哈……现在……还剩下多少……

10 seconds remaining.
还有10秒。

4 seconds.
4秒。

4? Why are you not... doing this by multiples of 5...?!
一般……这种时候不是每5秒倒数一次的吗……？

Look alive, deckhands! Put your back into it! Toil, men! Toil!
所有人闭嘴，给我全力上！

Somehow, we managed to escape the zone before Faust counted down to zero.
我们好不容易在浮士德的倒数结束之前离开了那片区域。

Some Sinners immediately threw themselves to the deck of the ship like limp puppets, while some looked like they'd just taken a quick rest at a park bench.
奋力踩完踏板的罪人们有的就这样往甲板上一躺，有的则像是从长椅上站起一般，若无其事地离开了原地。

<So... we made it somehow, but...>
<总算……离开了，不过……>

I don't see any signs of those 'laws'... Am I missing something... Frau Faust?
完全没有看到任何有关规则的征兆……是我看漏了什么吗……浮士德小姐？

Agh... I swear, if all this 'law of the Great Lake' drivel was some hogwash you made up...
呵……不会规则之类的只是胡说八道吧……

... just to make this journey go just a tad faster, I'm going to seriously...
如果只是想把我们当狗一般随意使唤的话，可不能就这么算了……

The tranquil Lake surface we just pedaled through... was gone, as though it was never even there.
有谁能想到，在数秒前我们经过的那个还算平静的湖面上。

In its place was an immense... something. Its innumerable legs—or tentacles—writhed, rising above the Lake's surface. I couldn't even tell where the thing ended and where the Lake began.
已经被什么巨大生物的腕足……或者说是触手，或者说是难以名状的某种存在所占据了。

Did it burst from the Lake? Or...
那是从湖底出现的吗，还是说……

Were we traveling unawares on its body this whole time?
我们从最开始……就一无所知地在那种存在身上航行吗？

PHWAAAH?!
噗呜啊啊？！

I couldn't even find the right word to describe the magnitude of that thing. Its appearance sent waves across the waters all the way to the zone we were in...
难以仅靠巨大一词形容的那东西的出现，在我们刚刚离开的区域中引发了滔天巨浪……

Mephistopheles shook violently as though it was about to capsize. It need not be said that the Sinners on the deck were given an untimely shower.
梅菲斯托费勒斯仿佛要倾倒般剧烈摇晃着，身边的罪人们理所当然地被迫洗了个澡。

Woah... That was too close! We were almost pancaked...
哇……稍微迟一点大家就要变成藻屑了……

W-well! No a-adventure is complete with uh, cough, cough... nar-nary a peril, of course...
冒……冒险……不正是……咳咳。艰难……之事吗……

N.B. Now this is more like it.
很·好。这种杀起来才够味。

We have no chance of weathering a single strike from one of its limbs.
如果我们再遭到同样的攻击，就没有胜算了。

No. But 'it' will leave us alone as long as we are 'here'.
不，只要在“这里”，“它”就不会对我们怎么样了。

That is the law of the Great Lake.
这就是大湖的规则。

Now we have time for my explanations.
现在我可以对之前的事情进行说明了。

dataList.place: 梅菲斯托费勒斯 船舱
dataList.content:
Though the laws of the Great Lake are numerous, I will relay only the pertinent information for now.
虽然大湖的规则多种多样，但我当前仅做简短且必要的说明。

Lingering longer than a predetermined amount of time in a single Lake will cause one to be struck by the 'Waves' of each Lake.
如果在一片湖域中停留一定时间以上，各湖域的“浪潮”就会席卷而来。

'Waves'...? That didn't look like any waves I've seen before.
嘶……那种东西能叫做浪潮吗……？

There are also laws governing the time and direction in which ships are permitted to cross the borders between the Lakes.
渡过湖域间的界限也需要特定的时间与条件。

Wait up. So... if we ever just come to a stop for a bit, that... octopus tentacle-like thing'll whack us?
慢着，所以……只要我们稍微停下来一点，那些章鱼触手……什么的就会打过来了？

Precisely. Thus, it naturally follows that everything on the Great Lake is in a constant state of motion to position itself according to the laws.
正因如此，必然的……大湖上一切事物都在不断地改变位置，以适应大湖的规则。

And the route toward our destination will also change accordingly.
指引我们抵达目的地的路线，也会因此变动。

Hmm... Can I get, like, a written list of these laws? My nanny used to stick a piece of paper with our family rules in my room. Not that I could follow them all, but…
嗯……这些规则有被记录下来吗？我的乳母会将家规整理在纸上贴在我的房间里。虽然很难完全遵守就是了……

That's when...
就在那时……

... I heard a door open. Whoever opened it did so with obvious irritation.
我听见了门被猛地推开的声音。

... The Waves finally hit, huh?
……浪潮终于来了，对吧？

<Ish... mael?>
<以实……玛利？>

After such a long period of isolation, Ishmael staggered out of her room at last.
至今为止一直没有现身的以实玛利，晃晃悠悠地走了出来。

You can't just scribble the laws of the Great Lake down on a notepad and call it a day. Each Lake has wildly different sets of laws, even though the overarching laws governing the Great Lake are pretty straightforward.
大湖的规则不是在笔记本上潦草地写上两行就能解决的事情。虽然大湖本身的规则相当简单，但每片湖域的规则都千差万别。

More importantly, you should know that unauthorized recording of their laws is one of U Corp's better-known Taboos.
说到底未经许可就以文字记述大湖的规则本身，就是U公司著名的禁忌。

Then my body will remember it.
那就镌刻在身体上。

... Tattooing them on your body, if that is what you are referring to, is also prohibited.
……如果你指的并非镌刻记忆而是用墨水纹在身上，那也在禁忌之列。

Taboo Hunters of U Corp. have been sent in pursuit of individuals who have attempted precisely that. It is best that we do not produce any written records of their laws.
这或许会引来U公司派遣的禁忌猎人。一切规则都以口述形式传达才更为安全。

<… What have you been doing all this time, Ishmael?>
<……你一直在做什么，以实玛利？>

Whetting my harpoon.
在打磨捕鲸枪。

<Your harpoon? Why?>
<为什么又要打磨？>

Because I need it to be sharper.
因为要让它再锋利些。

Because I'll give her the kind of pain that makes her wish she was dead. She'll feel it, even from the smallest cuts.
即便只是轻微擦过，也要让它们对“活着”这一事实感到后悔，痛苦不堪。

… Then why don't you spare us from your misery and crawl back into your hole.
……那你就继续窝着去，现在跑出来干什么。

I'm afraid that if I did, I'd later emerge to a deck littered with your melted, unrecognizable flesh.
因为我觉得要是再这么窝着，马上就能看见你们被溶解殆尽的样子了。

And I'm not rearing to see a sight like that again.
再经历一次那样的事情可并不愉快。

Besides...
另外……

Watching you landsmen waste time tinkering with a ship you don't even understand, wasting precious time... has been unbearable.
我可不想再旁观一群对湖一无所知的人把时间浪费在摆弄船只上了。

Even though it's been a long time since the incident at the Boatworks, her biting yet anxious lectures have not dulled at all.
自修船厂事件已经过去了许久，但以实玛利毒舌凶猛的来势依然分毫不减。

I was afraid that she might stir up trouble among the Sinners again...
虽然我有些担心她会再次在罪人间引发骚乱……

<... Okay, fine.>
<……好，我明白了。>

But she was out here with the rest of us, and I wanted to believe that that was more than enough. I decided not to question her further.
但不问理由，现在她至少愿意露面，这就足够了。所以我决定不去刨根问底，继续追问她了。

... Hm. I had a feeling this would happen.
……嗯。我早有预感。

Ishmael walked up to the helm.
以实玛利摇晃着走了过来，握住船舵。

What are you doing? We are smooth sailing at the moment. A northbound breeze is pushing us along.
你在做什么？我们正在平稳航行。不如说这股南风让我们的航速更快了。

I guess it could look that way for some people. Simple, one-dimensional, predictable ground pounders like you.
大概是吧。只拘泥在陆地上的人脑子里的想法就是这么单纯乐观。

You little... How dare you insult my—
你这婆娘……你怎么敢这样跟我奥提斯……

<Outis, let's hear her out.>
<奥提斯，让她说来听听吧。>

... You got lucky, swabbie.
……算你走运，海猴子。

<Okay, Ishmael. Tell us... How are we not smooth-sailing? We've got the wind at our backs.>
<以实玛利，能稍微解释一下吗。这艘船现在……应该是顺风航行的吧？>

That's no wind.
那并不是因为风。

We're getting dragged.
我们正被拉着走。

<Dragged? By what?>
<拉着走？被什么？>

Those ships.
……被那些船。
